title: LBBL Round 4 of Finals. Basket Esch celebrate the title
description: Esch - Amicale 82-71 Basket Esch clinched the Total League title. They overcame Amicale at home court in Game 4 to win the championship series 3-1. The game without a history. Esch led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. Worth to mention a great performance of American swingman Jordan Hicks (201-1990, college: Loyola, IL) who helped to win the game recording 23 points and 9 rebounds. The former international power forward Clancy Rugg (204-1991, college: Vermont) contributed with 19 points and 7 rebounds for the winners. American swingman Jarvis Williams (198-1989, college: MSU, agency: BIG) replied with a double-double by scoring 24 points and 13 rebounds and his fellow American import forward Alex Reese (206-1999, college: Alabama, agency: Interperformances) added 19 points and 15 rebounds in the effort for Amicale.
